When capacitors are connected in series, the reciprocal of the equivalent capacitance is the sum of the reciprocals of the individual capacitances.  

For five capacitors each of \( C = 5\ \mu\text{F} \):  

\[
\frac{1}{C_{eq}} = \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5}
\]
\[
\frac{1}{C_{eq}} = \frac{5}{5} = 1
\]
\[
C_{eq} = 1\ \mu\text{F}
\]

Final answer: (D)
